strategies.name: INTRADAY_15M_RUNNER_FADE
strategies.schedule: 06:45 AM PT -> 07:45 AM PT (1-Hr Scheduled Hold)
strategies.description: Waits 15 minutes to bypass open chaos. Shorts overextended morning spike runners (>= +1.0% to +1.5%) with tight dynamic ratchet (+0.6% locks BE, +1.2% locks +0.6%, +2% locks +1.2%, +3% trails 1%).

strategies.name: ORB_30M_TREND_RATCHET
strategies.description: Waits 30 minutes for institutional reference levels to set. Takes trend continuation trades > 30M High or < 30M Low supported by VWAP, riding trends with stepped profit ratchets until 12:50 PM PT close.
